seo-crawler-cli: Crawl a site from a script or CI. Checks status codes, redirect chains, titles, meta descriptions, H1s, canonicals, noindex and broken links, and fails the build on regressions.
seo-audit-action: Crawl a staging or preview URL on every pull request. Fails the check on broken links, missing titles, noindex and redirect chains, with the details as a PR comment.
seo-mcp-server: Crawl a site, list SEO issues, inspect pages and find broken links from inside Claude, Cursor and other AI assistants.
redirect-chain-checker: Follow every hop of a URL's redirects and flag chains, loops, HTTPS downgrades, meta refreshes and redirects to error pages.
xml-sitemap-validator: Check a sitemap or sitemap index against the sitemaps.org protocol and search engine limits. Flags bad URLs, lastmod dates and cross-host entries.
robots-txt-tester: Fetch and lint a robots.txt, test which URLs each crawler may fetch and see the deciding line. Fails deploys that block the site.
hreflang-checker: Validate the hreflang tags on a page or across a whole XML sitemap, including self-reference, x-default and return tags.
schema-markup-validator: Check every schema.org node on a page against the required and recommended properties for rich results.
seo-crawl-export-spec: An open format for site crawl data: JSON Schema and CSV column reference, with a real sample export and a validator script.
seo-crawl-export-js: Load, query and convert site crawl data in JavaScript and TypeScript, with typed pages, issues by type and status filters.
screaming-frog-export-converter: Turn an SEO Spider internal_all.csv into the open JSON crawl export format, with a report of which columns carried over.
seo-audit-google-sheets: An Apps Script add-on that turns a site crawl export into an audit workbook: pages, issues by type, pages by status and title and meta flags.
wordpress-seo-connector: Bulk-apply fixes from the Crawl Cove desktop crawler to Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or AIOSEO, with a change log and one-click revert.
seo-chrome-extension: On-page SEO checker with an AI visibility report: which AI crawlers can read the page, snippet blocks, llms.txt and extractability. Nothing leaves the browser.
